answer:
Here is what I'd raise at your check-up, most important first.

1. Lung nodule follow-up (overdue). The CT you had in the ER on Oct 18, 2025 for your kidney stone also found an incidental 7 mm solid nodule in the right lower lung. The radiologist recommended a chest CT in 6-12 months, so the window ran from about April to October 2026. I can't find a chest CT or any mention of the nodule in your later records. Ask for this to be arranged soon.

2. Repeat thyroid tests (overdue). Your TSH was mildly high (7.9) in the hospital in March 2026, with a normal free T4. The discharge instructions asked for TSH and free T4 to be repeated in 6-8 weeks. I see no repeat in your records. Your June blood work didn't include them.

3. Hydrochlorothiazide doesn't add up. You were hospitalized in March 2026 with a sodium of 123, attributed to hydrochlorothiazide, and told to stop it. But the eye clinic's May 2026 list, which you reported yourself, still shows it as a daily medicine, and the pharmacy and clinic records still show it as active. Your sodium on June 15 was again slightly low (134), and the clinic note that day just says to continue current medications. Please confirm with your doctor whether you are taking it and what the plan is. Also ask for a sodium recheck.

4. Vaccines. You had your first Shingrix dose on Nov 8, 2025. I see no second dose, which is normally given 2-6 months after the first. Your last flu shot was Nov 8, 2025, so this season's is due. Pneumococcal (Prevnar 20) is done.

5. Diabetes checks. Your A1c is 6.6% (down from 6.9%), and your eye exam in May 2026 showed no retinopathy; the next one is due about May 2027. I don't see a urine albumin/creatinine test or a documented foot exam. Also ask what came of the diabetes education referral.

6. Cholesterol. In Sept 2025 your LDL was 142, HDL 48 and triglycerides 155. You have diabetes and high blood pressure, and no cholesterol medicine or repeat lipid panel appears in your records. Ask whether a statin makes sense.

7. Cancer screening. Your 2019 colonoscopy was normal, with a repeat in 10 years (about 2029), so it's not due. I can't find a mammogram or cervical screening in these records. They may have been done elsewhere, so check.

8. Records housekeeping. One hospital export still lists lisinopril as active, though it was stopped in Sept 2025 for cough. Several sources list your medicines as duplicates. A reconciled list at the visit would help. Your kidney stone is still marked active with no follow-up recorded, so ask whether it passed.

Blood pressure was at goal on June 15 (128/80), and your plan was to return in about 6 months.
short: Overdue: chest CT for a 7 mm lung nodule found Oct 2025, repeat TSH/free T4 after TSH 7.9 in March 2026, and Shingrix dose 2. Hydrochlorothiazide was stopped for hyponatremia in March but still appears on current lists, and sodium was 134 in June.
